target: gap from the last regular close to the next regular open, per stock
predicted_at: 09:00 New York time on the opening day

general_tool_premarket.method: the stock's own last pre-market print at or before 09:00 New York (Yahoo, includePrePost), over the prior regular close; and the console's implied open at 03:30 New York, before any pre-market, over the same close
general_tool_premarket.not_run: Blue Ocean ATS overnight quotes (paid feed)

costs_net.entry_rule: enter on the perpetual at the read: long if the estimate is more than 12bps above the perpetual's price, short if more than 12bps below, else stand aside
costs_net.exit: the stock's regular open; realized on the move from the perpetual's price at the read to that open, net of the round trip when a position is opened, zero when the night was skipped

out_of_sample.method: walk-forward per stock: every fitted candidate is refit before each night on that stock's earlier nights only

console_replay.method: lui/research/quote.py::_implied_open_line called per night at 09:00 New York, its market readers pointed at data/h2h_gloaming/inputs.json (console_feed); the gap is the printed implied price over the session's regular close
console_replay.sample_line: Implied open: AAPL's perpetual has moved +0.70% since the Mon 20:00 UTC close, which puts the stock near 248.35 at the next open (last close 246.63). Read this way on AAPL on 113 nights, the open was missed by 26bps on average, with the direction right 90% of the time; gloaming, an S2 desk that estimates overnight fair value from index futures, crypto and the dollar, missed by 66bps, and assuming no gap by 58bps.

scope: Rows before a stock's 11th night are excluded from every candidate so the walk-forward fits are out of sample on the same rows as the fixed ones. gloaming's crypto input is Bitget USDT perpetuals, not spot.

comparison_reports.question: the stock's overnight gap
comparison_reports.metric: mean absolute error of the predicted close-to-open gap, bps
comparison_reports.basis: paired bootstrap over nights, 4000 draws, seed 7; ARGUS is the console's _implied_open_line replayed on the saved inputs; ARGUS better if the whole 95% interval of (ARGUS - rival) absolute error is below zero

comparison_reports.question: the stock's overnight gap: the floor
comparison_reports.metric: mean absolute error of the predicted close-to-open gap, bps
comparison_reports.basis: paired bootstrap over nights, 4000 draws, seed 7; ARGUS is the console's _implied_open_line replayed on the saved inputs; ARGUS better if the whole 95% interval of (ARGUS - rival) absolute error is below zero

comparison_reports.question: the stock's overnight gap, read at 09:00 New York
comparison_reports.rival: the stock's own pre-market price at 09:00 (the general tool)
comparison_reports.metric: mean absolute error of the predicted close-to-open gap, bps
comparison_reports.basis: paired bootstrap over nights, 4000 draws, seed 7, on the rows where both estimates exist

comparison_reports.question: the stock's overnight gap, read at 03:30 New York
comparison_reports.rival: no gap (the last close), before pre-market
comparison_reports.metric: mean absolute error of the predicted close-to-open gap, bps
comparison_reports.basis: paired bootstrap over nights, 4000 draws, seed 7, on the rows where both estimates exist

comparison_reports.question: the Monday open from Sunday 20:00 New York
comparison_reports.rival: nocturne's claim: the last regular close
comparison_reports.metric: mean absolute error of the predicted Friday-close-to-Monday-open gap, bps
comparison_reports.basis: paired bootstrap over weekends, 4000 draws, seed 7
